correctness.rationale: Maximal abelian H contains the entire central edge space. Edge brackets imply proportional coordinate restrictions on connected components of the active support. Inclusion maximality extends each such component to one full-support line, and the centralizer is exactly the resulting space iff the support dominates the graph. Projective-line counting yields the asserted coefficients, uniform over all prime powers including characteristic two. Independently checked 300 graph-field combinations by RREF enumeration and centralizer rank; infinite statement follows from proof, not experiments.

Gives weighted dominating-set polynomial, independence-number degree, multiplicativity, explicit complete-bipartite family, and a pair of graphs proving strict refinement beyond the ordinary independence polynomial; meaningful structural arithmetic information, not an isolated low-dimension recomputation.
